content: Yehoba Abalam I Yogaan
Yehoba i baek Abalam elana i ba, “Wam panuwa, tutumwau, ge tamwam wana limi ana heniheni nu eguluwagil nu na panuwa toto abwe na pankitewa.

content.text: Yaka tubutubumwau nihi gewi na pewa nihi tabwa boda gasigasisena etega, ge na mulolu-agiwa.
Alam na pwabwata, ge owa eliyam gamagalau mulolu nihi pwawa.
Bolo nihi mulolu-agiwa nau na mulolu-agil, yaa bolo ami hehegan hi apapanak-an nau na nuwamut-agil.
Ge owa eliyam un gegewel panayawiya na muloluagil.”

content: Abalam wana baliman 75, yaka panuwa Halani i eguluwai ge i nawanawa, i ola Yehoba wana baaba eliyana. He Lote al ge i nok alona.

Abalam, lagona Selai ge talina natuna Lote i ahel alonau, ginebi gogomwau gegewena ge totuwalali gegewel bolo hi pwawal Halani elana. Yaka panuwa o hi eguluwai ge hi nawanawa Kenani kaiwena. Sauga hi vin,
inoke Abalam labi Kenani gamwana i nosolaan ge i nawanawa i na i vin Mole wana kawadi bwabwalena elana panuwa Sekemi elana. He saugenana o Kenani gamagaliliyau iyoho ya hi minamina labi Kenani elana.
Yaka Yehoba i masal Abalam elana ge i ba, “Labi toto ya ya pewa tubutubumwau eliyalil.” Yaka Abalam pat i pahe abapowon i ginol panuwa o elana ge i tapwaloloek Yehoba elana, iya i masala elana.

Toto o enaa, yaka Abalam i egon i noek labi manaoyaoya elana panuwa Betel labi nati, ge wana epanapana i pamilil panuwa Betel ge Ai ali luwaluwala. He panuwa Betel i minek labi pai ge panuwa Ai i minek labi nati. Yaka abapowon etega al i ginol ge i tapwalolo Yehoba elana.
Toto o enaa, yaka i novevehe al i nanawa labi kekevana Negeb kaiwena.
Abalam I Na Itipita
Yaka galebu bwabwatana etega i masal labi Kenani elana. He galebu o i bwata hot, inoke Abalam i na Itipita ge i miminek ga to.
Kelaubwa Abalam ni vin Itipita ana labiya, yaka i baek lagona elana i ba, “Selai, ya atena te am awa i waisi hot.
He ebo Itipita nihi kitewa, nasi nihi ba, ‘Lagona to.’ Yaka nihi tagapaaligau ge owa nihi pwamolowa.
He nu baek eliyalil nu ba, ‘Nu te,’ inoke owa kaiwem o hehegan nihi abubun ge yawaliu nihi pwamwal.”
Sauga Abalam i na i vin Itipita, yaka Itipita gamagaliliyau Selai hi kite ana awa i waisi hot.
I ola al kin wana totuwalali bwabwatal Selai hi kite, inoke hi na kin elana ge ana awa hi awa wawaisi-an ge hi tobalan. Yaka hi na hi ahe ge hi en pwatanik kin wana limiya, alona hi mina.
He kin Abalam ana hehegan i ginol bubun, kaiwena Selai i ahe alona hi mina wana limiya, yaka wana sipi, goti, bulumwakau, donki, kamel ge wana totuwalali loloyowanil ona i bugul pek.
Yaa Yehoba kasiyebwa nanakina hot etega i patuna kin alonau ge wana limi ana heniheni gegewel hi kasiyebwa, kaiwena kin Abalam lagona Selai i ahe tukan alona hi mina wana limiya.
Inoke kin Abalam ana baaba i patuna ge i nok elana. Sauga i vin yaka i neli i ba, “Hauna pagan u ginol eliyau e? Hauna kaiwena nige no wasa u pepem te Selai iya lagom?
Hauna kaiwena u ba tage iya num, ge ya ahe i ola lagou? He lagom hiwe! U ahe ge ku egon.”
Inoke kin i baek awana toabinau elal, yaka Abalam alona lagona hi patuna owaowa-agil ginebi ge wali gogomwau gegewena Itipita hi eguluwan.
